files.description: Main Razor page demonstrating all compatible C# 8.0 features with comprehensive examples
features: Using declarations for automatic resource disposal
Static local functions for better performance
Indices and ranges for array operations

code_samples.code: var dayType = today switch { DayOfWeek.Saturday or DayOfWeek.Sunday => "Weekend", DayOfWeek.Monday => "Monday Blues", _ => "Regular Weekday" };
code_samples.notes: Demonstrates concise switch expression syntax with pattern matching and logical operators

code_samples.code: string ClassifyPerson(Person person) => person switch { { Age: < 13 } => "Child", { Age: >= 65 } => "Senior", _ => "Adult" };
code_samples.notes: Shows property pattern matching with complex age-based conditions

code_samples.code: string DescribePoint((int x, int y) point) => point switch { (0, 0) => "Origin", (0, _) => "On Y-axis", (_, 0) => "On X-axis", _ => "Other" };
code_samples.notes: Demonstrates tuple pattern matching with wildcard usage

code_samples.code: using var stream = new MemoryStream(); using var writer = new StreamWriter(stream);
code_samples.notes: Automatic resource disposal without explicit using blocks

code_samples.code: static int Factorial(int x) => x <= 1 ? 1 : x * Factorial(x - 1);
code_samples.notes: Local function that cannot capture variables, providing better performance

code_samples.code: var lastElement = numbers[^1]; var firstThree = numbers[0..3]; var lastTwo = numbers[^2..];
code_samples.notes: New syntax for array element access and slicing operations
Assigns value only if left operand is null, simplifying null checks

unsupported_features.explanation: ref structs that implement IDisposable pattern cannot be effectively demonstrated in Razor context due to ref struct limitations in method calls and storage. They require unsafe code patterns that are not suitable for web page contexts.
Generic types with unmanaged type constraints require unsafe code context, which is not suitable for Razor pages. These features are primarily for low-level programming scenarios.
Using stackalloc in more expression contexts requires unsafe operations, which are not practical in Razor page context. Stack allocation is meant for performance-critical, low-level code.
